featured_title: Can You Transfer Your Flood Insurance to the Buyer? Southwest Florida 2026
featured_excerpt: If your flood policy is written through the NFIP, you can assign it to your buyer at closing instead of cancelling it, and FEMA confirms the discount and the statutory glide-path rate transfer with the property. In a market where Estero homes close at 92.7% of asking price after 69 days, that paperwork is one of the few levers a seller still controls.
